sentences.en: The professor explained the concept that students found difficult in a clear way.
sentences.zh: 教授用一种清晰的方式讲解了学生们觉得困难的那个概念。

chunks.zh: 学生们觉得困难的(定从)

sentences.en: Because the experiment failed, the researchers redesigned their method carefully.
sentences.zh: 因为实验失败了,研究人员们仔细地重新设计了他们的方法。

sentences.en: The report, which the committee published yesterday, surprised many economists.
sentences.zh: 委员会昨天发布的那份报告让许多经济学家感到惊讶。

chunks.zh: 委员会昨天发布的(定从)

sentences.en: Students who review their notes regularly tend to perform better on exams.
sentences.zh: 定期复习笔记的学生在考试中往往表现更好。

sentences.en: It is essential that every applicant submit the form before Friday.
sentences.zh: 每位申请者在星期五之前提交表格是必不可少的。

chunks.en: that every applicant submit the form
chunks.zh: 每位申请者提交表格(主语从)

sentences.en: The new policy, despite its high cost, has improved the school's safety record significantly.
sentences.zh: 尽管成本很高,这项新政策显著改善了学校的安全记录。

sentences.en: Not until the lights went out did the audience realize how powerful the speech had been.
sentences.zh: 直到灯光熄灭,观众才意识到那场演讲有多么有力量。

chunks.en: Not until the lights went out
how powerful the speech had been
chunks.zh: 那场演讲曾有多有力量(宾从)

sentences.en: The author argues that economic growth alone cannot solve the problem of inequality.
sentences.zh: 作者认为,仅靠经济增长无法解决不平等问题。

chunks.en: that economic growth alone cannot solve the problem
chunks.zh: 仅靠经济增长无法解决这个问题(宾从)

sentences.en: Having finished the project ahead of schedule, the team celebrated with a small dinner.
sentences.zh: 由于提前完成了项目,团队以一顿小晚餐来庆祝。

chunks.en: Having finished the project ahead of schedule
chunks.zh: 提前完成了项目(分词状)

sentences.en: What the survey revealed was that most voters cared more about jobs than about taxes.
sentences.zh: 调查揭示的是,大多数选民更关心就业而不是税收。

chunks.en: that most voters cared more about jobs
chunks.zh: 大多数选民更关心就业(表语从)
